verdict.rationale: GitBook documents 'Content variants' as part of site structure, and sites can be organized into sections and groups. That points to multiple published content sets within one site, but the pack never says variants map to product or API versions or that readers get a version switcher. The 'Version control' page concerns editing history and Git workflows, not reader-facing published versions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that variants serve per-version docs, a documented reader version switcher, per-API-version OpenAPI publishing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
